archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) combined with Fantasy RPG elements

global_rules.emotion_mantra: The learning challenge should feel like casting a spell or empowering an attack rather than taking a test.
global_rules.accessibility: WCAG AA min on every label over the 3D backdrop. Use frosted/translucent panels with sufficient contrast.

media_urls.description: Fixed 3D arena backdrop for the battle scene. MUST use as the CSS background-image (background-size: cover; background-position: center) behind EVERY mockup state.

typography.rules: Use highly legible, friendly, rounded sans-serif fonts where possible. Ensure high contrast.

philosophies.name: Option 1 — Pokémon (Game-First)
philosophies.description: Very game-first; the question feels like a battle command panel.
philosophies.modal_style: Sharp but slightly rounded edges (rounded-xl), solid opaque panels with heavy borders. Dimming is moderate (bg-black/40).
philosophies.interaction: Direct click confirms the answer immediately.

philosophies.name: Option 2 — Hearthstone (Premium Card)
philosophies.description: Large magical card; premium feel; lots of motion potential.
philosophies.modal_style: Card-like interface (rounded-2xl) with ornate inner borders, heavy drop shadows, and glowing edges. Strong arena dimming/blur (bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-md).
philosophies.interaction: Select an answer to highlight it, then click a large 'Cast Spell' CTA to confirm.

philosophies.name: Option 3 — Disney Dreamlight Valley (Cozy & Whimsical)
philosophies.description: Soft, cozy, rounded, whimsical; tuned perfectly for elementary students.
philosophies.modal_style: Ultra-rounded (rounded-3xl or full pill shapes), soft glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-lg), friendly pastel borders. Light dimming to keep the 3D world visible (bg-purple-900/20 backdrop-blur-sm).
philosophies.interaction: Select an answer, then click a playful 'Try it!' button.

states_to_render.name: 1. Default action selection
states_to_render.description: Idle creatures, full action bar visible at the bottom.

states_to_render.name: 2. Question modal open
states_to_render.description: 'Attack' pressed. Modal layered over the 3D arena. Arena visibly dimmed/blurred but NOT hidden. Question: 'What is 7 × 8?' Options: 42, 54, 56, 64.

states_to_render.name: 3. Correct answer
states_to_render.description: Modal swaps to a celebratory state with green/gold accents, sparkles, and 'Spell charged!' messaging. Includes small explanation.

states_to_render.name: 4. Wrong answer
states_to_render.description: Modal swaps to a kind, encouraging 'try again' state (warm orange/coral, NOT red/scary). Reveals the correct answer (56) and explanation. CTA: 'Continue'.

states_to_render.name: 5. Quiz action disabled/locked
states_to_render.description: Action bar shows 'Quiz' button greyed out with a small 'Unlocks soon' lock chip.

hp_cards.layout: Player card bottom-left, enemy card top-right. Absolutely positioned over the backdrop.
hp_cards.elements: Name, level chip (e.g., Lvl 5), HP bar (80/80) with visual fill, small avatar swatch.

battle_log.layout: Small, readable, ambient text overlay (e.g., 'Embercub is ready!'). Usually placed above the action bar or top-center.

action_bar.buttons: Attack (primary CTA, biggest, glowing), Defend, Quiz (locked state), Run Away.
action_bar.elements: Each button needs an icon + label + optional small subtitle.

elements: Four multiple-choice answer buttons (Grid 2x2 or 1x4 list depending on philosophy)
Read aloud button (speaker icon) for the main question
Small Read aloud speaker icon beside each answer
Submit button OR direct click (varies by philosophy)
Explanation area (1-2 lines, appears in correct/wrong states)
Continue / Cast attack CTA after feedback

instructions_to_main_agent.file_creation: Create /app/frontend/src/pages/design/Battle3dDesign.jsx (Ensure it is a single file design exploration page, ~600 lines max, break into inline components).
instructions_to_main_agent.structure: The page must have a 'Designer's pick + why' callout at the top. Then 3 main sections (one for each philosophy). Each section must stack the 5 states vertically. Use the provided 3D backdrop URL as the background image for EVERY state container.
instructions_to_main_agent.annotations: Add kid-friendly tooltip-style callouts/annotations inline for each philosophy to explain spacing, hierarchy, and button placement choices.
instructions_to_main_agent.comparison_table: Add a comparison table at the bottom of the page summarizing trade-offs: Motion Budget, Kid-friendliness (6-10 yo), Screen-Real-Estate Cost, Accessibility Score.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: CRITICAL: Apply unique data-testid attributes to EVERY interactive and state element (e.g., data-testid='philosophy-pokemon-state-default', data-testid='answer-btn-pokemon-56').
instructions_to_main_agent.styling_notes: Use lucide-react for icons. Use framer-motion for simple state transitions and hover effects. Do NOT use emojis. Ensure minimum tap targets of 44px. Do NOT build real 3D scenes, just use the background image.
instructions_to_main_agent.designers_pick_rationale: Recommend Option 3 (Disney Dreamlight Valley) because its soft, cozy glassmorphism and encouraging feedback loops perfectly mitigate test-anxiety for elementary students while keeping the 3D world feeling integrated and alive.
